scenarios.title_zh: UCP #354/#353/#342/#370 能力级 OAuth Scope 与订单/Webhook 签名头合规基线
scenarios.title_en: UCP #354/#353/#342/#370 Capability OAuth Scopes & Order/Webhook Headers Baseline
scenarios.question_zh: 当 UCP 身份绑定使用反向域名 Scope、RFC 8414 元数据、PKCE S256、variant.options 及独立 Webhook/订单签名头时，是否自动放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should checkout auto-admit when UCP identity linking uses reverse-DNS scopes, RFC 8414 metadata, PKCE S256, variant.options, and separated webhook/order signature headers?

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #354 旧版 ucp:scopes:* 枚举、能力协商剪枝与 RFC 8414 非 404 回退拦截
scenarios.title_en: UCP #354 Legacy ucp:scopes:*, Capability Pruning & Non-404 OIDC Fallback Block
scenarios.question_zh: 当请求仍携带旧版 ucp:scopes:checkout、因身份绑定剪枝能力协商或在 RFC 8414 返回 500 时回退 OIDC 时，护栏是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block legacy ucp:scopes:checkout scopes, capability pruning on identity linking, or falling back to OIDC on RFC 8414 HTTP 500?

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #354 PKCE plain 降级、issuer 尾斜杠失配与缺失 identity_required 拦截
scenarios.title_en: UCP #354 PKCE plain Downgrade, Issuer Trailing-Slash & Missing identity_required Block
scenarios.question_zh: 当 OAuth 降级为 PKCE plain、issuer 含尾斜杠不一致或 auth_required=true 缺失令牌却未返回 identity_required 时，是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block PKCE plain downgrade, trailing-slash issuer mismatch, or missing identity_required when auth_required=true?

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #353/#342/#370 旧版 selected_options、Webhook 包体泄漏 event_id 与缺失签名头拦截
scenarios.title_en: UCP #353/#342/#370 Legacy selected_options, Body event_id Leak & Missing Digest Block
scenarios.question_zh: 当商品变体仍用 selected_options、Webhook 包体残留 event_id 或 get_order 缺失 Content-Digest 头时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block legacy variant.selected_options, webhook body event_id leakage, or missing Content-Digest on get_order?

scenarios.title_zh: ACP #89/#83 JSONPath extends 扩展声明与增强结账父子层级/免税证书合规基线
scenarios.title_en: ACP #89/#83 JSONPath extends & Enhanced Checkout Hierarchy/Tax Exemption Baseline
scenarios.question_zh: 当 ACP 扩展使用 $. JSONPath、叠加折扣分摊守恒且 LineItem 层级与免税证书有效时，是否自动放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should ACP checkout auto-admit when extensions use $. JSONPath, stacked discount allocations conserve sums, and LineItem hierarchy/tax exemption are valid?

scenarios.title_zh: ACP #89 非 JSONPath 扩展路径、重复折扣优先级与 each 分摊失衡拦截
scenarios.title_en: ACP #89 Non-JSONPath extends, Duplicate Priority & each Allocation Drift Block
scenarios.question_zh: 当 ACP 扩展 extends 未使用 $. JSONPath，或叠加折扣 priority 重复且 each 分摊总和不等时，是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block non-JSONPath extends strings, duplicate discount priorities, or method='each' allocation sum drift?

scenarios.title_zh: ACP #83 LineItem.item 内嵌 quantity、超限购数量与悬空 parent_id 拦截
scenarios.title_en: ACP #83 Embedded item.quantity, Max Order Exceeded & Dangling parent_id Block
scenarios.question_zh: 当 LineItem.item 违规内嵌 quantity、购买数量超 max_quantity_per_order 或 parent_id 悬空时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block embedded LineItem.item.quantity, quantity exceeding max_quantity_per_order, or dangling parent_id?

scenarios.title_zh: ACP #83 买家免税证书过期与跨州未覆盖地区逃税拦截
scenarios.title_en: ACP #83 Expired Buyer Tax Exemption Certificate & Uncovered Region Block
scenarios.question_zh: 当买家声明 tax_exempt=true 但免税证书已过期或订单地区不在 exempt_regions 中时，是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block tax-exempt checkout when buyer.tax_exemption is expired or does not cover the order region?

scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block @x402/base on non-Base chains (eip155:137) or server roles registering client-only auth-capture?

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra tau2-bench #348/#352 非英语运行退化为原始子串匹配与缺失 [llm_judge] 拦截
scenarios.title_en: Sierra tau2-bench #348/#352 Non-English Substring Fallback & Missing [llm_judge] Block

scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block when an English run injects <lang>/<script> hints or leaks multilingual personas into the regular sampling pool?
